_meta.about: Machine-checkable brand rules. tools/guard.py runs every rule with check=auto; /bec (the model) runs check=judge on the render. severity block = build cannot be declared done; advise = report and fix if reasonable. status provisional = value assumed until the matching guideline is dropped; feedback from the brand team updates it (see CHANGELOG.md and _feedback/).

rules.title: Colours come from the palette
rules.rule: Every colour literal in a build is in tokens.colour.core, restricted (in its allowed context), logo_belt or extended_web_bec. Anything else is foreign.
rules.tolerance: deltaE < 2.5 to an allowed colour = near-match, advisory; observed_not_authority colours = advisory
rules.source: wf_pattern_guidelines p3; BEC Figma colour page

rules.title: WF Red present
rules.rule: WF Red #FF0051 appears in every composition (background, graphic element or text accent).

rules.title: Restricted colours stay in context
rules.rule: #BC0050 only with the For Enterprise mark or enterprise buttons. #1677FF only inside the Ant International co-brand lockup files.

rules.title: Gradients use the four defined runs
rules.rule: linear-gradient stops match Red, Light Grey, Purple or Grey gradient (or the belt run). No invented gradients, no text gradients except the belt-less accent word.

rules.title: Poppins for EN, Alibaba PuHuiTi for CN
rules.rule: font-family declarations resolve to Poppins (Latin) and Alibaba PuHuiTi (CJK). No other families, no serif companion, no system fonts as a design choice.

rules.title: Weights in use
rules.rule: Poppins 400/500/600/700/800 (Thin to Light only with a reason). PuHuiTi 300/400/500/700/900.

rules.title: CN headings are Bold, not Extrabold
rules.rule: Any element with CJK text and font-weight >= 800 is a violation.

rules.title: Type scale follows BEC
rules.rule: Headline and body sizes sit on the tokens.typography.scale_bec_figma steps for the breakpoint; negative tracking on H1/H2 only.

rules.title: Logo files come from the library
rules.rule: Any WorldFirst logo, lockup or co-brand mark is one of the manifest files (sha1 match) or the identical inline SVG paths. No re-drawn, screenshot or third-party copies.

rules.title: Right variant for the ground
rules.rule: Positive logo on white / light grey. Reverse (white) logo on WF Red, Dark Purple, Purple and Grey grounds. Never the positive logo on a dark or red ground.
rules.source: logo file naming pos/rev; pairing pages

rules.title: Minimum size
rules.rule: Logo rendered no smaller than 24px tall on screen.
rules.source: assumed; logo guideline not in drop

rules.title: No recolour, no stretch, no effects
rules.rule: Library SVG used with its own fills (belt gradient intact); width/height ratio within 2% of the viewBox ratio; no filters, shadows or outlines on the mark.

rules.title: Never typeset the wordmark
rules.rule: 'WorldFirst' set in Poppins as a logo substitute is a violation. The wordmark is only the SVG.

rules.title: Clear space
rules.rule: Clear space around the logo at least the height of the 'W' on all sides; nothing crosses it.
rules.source: assumed; logo guideline not in drop

rules.title: Parent line and co-brand files
rules.rule: 'a brand of Ant International' is only shown through wf-lockup-brand-of-ant-*; Ant International | WorldFirst only through wf-cobrand-ant-international-*; WorldFirst × Alipay only through wf-cobrand-alipay-*. Never assembled by hand from separate marks.

rules.title: Enterprise mark only for enterprise
rules.rule: wf-enterprise-* lockups only on WorldFirst For Enterprise content; never mixed with the standard wordmark on the same surface.

rules.title: Partnership lockup construction
rules.rule: Partner logo LEFT, WorldFirst brandmark RIGHT, '+' separator, both marks at a matched maximum height. Optional description line beneath (sport template). Multi-partner: partners left in a row with grey divider bars, WorldFirst right. Enterprise partnerships use the For Enterprise mark.

rules.title: Alipay+ / Alipay marks from library only
rules.rule: Any image or SVG referencing alipay must be a manifest file.

rules.title: Icons from the library
rules.rule: Icons are the 14 library icons (manifest wf-icon-*). No Font Awesome, Lucide, Heroicons, Material or emoji icons in brand builds.

rules.title: One variant per composition
rules.rule: Primary, Reverse White, Duotone and Red Circular are not mixed on one surface. Reverse White only on dark grounds.

rules.title: Stroke spec for any new icon
rules.rule: 32px grid, 2px padding, 2px stroke, round cap, round join, corners rounded like the brandmark. New icons need BEC sign-off.

rules.title: Backgrounds from the library
rules.rule: Map and globe backgrounds are the exported files (wf-pattern-map, wf-pattern-globe) or the .ai masters; no re-drawn dot maps, no stock globes.

rules.title: Belt usage
rules.rule: The belt sweeps from a lower corner across the composition, WF Red into Orange, one belt per surface, never behind body text.

rules.title: Pairing follows the guideline
rules.rule: Background, main text, graphic element and supporting text follow tokens.background_pairings.

rules.title: Real people, natural poses
rules.rule: Genuine expressions, positive energy, no stock-style posing.

rules.title: Warm natural light, no oversaturation
rules.rule: Warm hues; avoid high contrast and oversaturated tones. Guard measures mean saturation and luminance spread as a hint.

rules.title: Business in action
rules.rule: Everyday operations in authentic settings: packing, inventory, deliveries; mix scale shots with detail.

rules.title: Local vibrancy and business diversity
rules.rule: Local markets, landmarks, crafts; represent trading shops, e-commerce merchants and enterprises.

rules.title: Moments of connection
rules.rule: Authentic interactions, shared smiles, engaged dialogue.

rules.title: Hero the WorldFirst Red
rules.rule: A WF Red cue is present in key-visual photography (measured as >=0.5% of pixels within deltaE 12 of #FF0051).

rules.title: Tagline exact
rules.rule: The master tagline is exactly 'One Account. Global Reach.' Case, punctuation and order fixed.

rules.title: No em-dashes
rules.rule: No em-dash (U+2014) anywhere in copy.

rules.title: Avoid-list
rules.rule: No 'game-changing', 'utilise', 'in today's world', 'seamless', 'revolutionise', 'world-class', 'cutting-edge', 'best-in-class', 'we're the best'.

rules.title: No exclamation marks in body copy
rules.rule: Exclamation marks flagged outside headlines.

rules.title: Parent line wording
rules.rule: 'a brand of Ant International' (lowercase a, exact wording) when the parent is named in text.

rules.title: Personality
rules.rule: Real (genuine, clear, human), Dependable (consistent, reliable), Energising (ambitious, optimistic). Confident, clear, no jargon, British English.

rules.title: AFA content routes through /afa_kit
rules.rule: If the build mentions Argentina, AFA, Messi, Vamos Argentina or the Alipay+ sponsorship, the AFA kit rules apply and must have been loaded.
